# Reserve 9 Year Old Canadian Whisky

Think of Reserve 9 year old as the more mature, older sibling of Canadian Club 1858 with a greater Rye influence. This whisky is aged for a full 9 years, bringing out the oak notes of the barrels and a spicier, more robust taste profile. Perfect for sipping neat or enjoying in a classic cocktail.

## Tasting notes

![Color Tasting Notes](https://www.canadianclub.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2024-11/color-tasting-notes-canadian-club.png.webp?itok=zPPj5C47)

### Color

Bronze gold

![Aroma Tasting](https://www.canadianclub.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2024-11/aroma-tasting-notes-canadian-club.png.webp?itok=hL9pmmXc)

### Aroma

Toffee and toasted oak, creamy, oaky vanilla

![Taste Tasting](https://www.canadianclub.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2024-11/taste-tasting-notes-canadian-club.png.webp?itok=r3i1wA50)

### Taste

English toffee, rich mellow oak with soft nutmeg and clove

![Finish Tasting](https://www.canadianclub.com/sites/default/files/styles/original/public/2024-11/finish-tasting-notes-canadian-club.png.webp?itok=vpEmPs1T)

### Finish

Warm and lingering dry finish with enduring presence of caramel and vanilla
